{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the distribution of severity
severity_counts = df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Extract the fraction for 'severe'
fraction_severe = severity_counts['severe']

fraction_severe"}
